_about: Standard tests a player records so scores can be compared fairly. Cone layouts are in metres: x runs along the drill, y across it. See pep/drills/runner.py.

sprint_30m.label: 30 m sprint
sprint_30m.how: Four cones: two on the start line 4 m apart, two on the finish line 30 m away. Phone on a tripod or wall, side-on, all four cones in shot. Start still, one foot on the line. The clock starts once you have moved 20 cm, like timing gates.

agility_5105.label: 5-10-5 agility
agility_5105.how: Middle line at 0, turn lines 5 m either side (mark both ends of each turn line). Start on the middle line, run 5 m one way, 10 m back, 5 m through the middle.

juggling.label: Keepy-ups
juggling.how: Whole body and ball in shot, ball never leaving the frame. As many touches as you can without the ball touching the ground. Any surface counts.

wall_passes.label: Wall passes (30 s)
wall_passes.how: Stand 3-5 m from a wall. Pass, control, pass again for 30 seconds. Camera side-on so the ball's path to the wall is visible.
